title: Hyperliquid’s $314M unlock fuels calls for clarity, sell-pressure warnings
summary: BitMEX co-founder Arthur Hayes said Hyperliquid’s $314 million unlock brings unavoidable sell pressure, saying insider assurances can’t remove uncertainty.

title: Blockchain is struggling to hold on to its original purpose: Aztec CEO
summary: Blockchain can still serve its purpose while catering to institutional finance needs through privacy technology, says Aztec Labs’ Zac Williamson.

title: $1.9B exodus and flicker of hope hits crypto investment funds: CoinShares
summary: Crypto investment products neared $5 billion in outflows in the last four weeks, but late-week inflows show early signs of improving sentiment despite heavy selling, CoinShares said.

title: How India’s VDA review may strengthen protections across the crypto ecosystem
summary: From custody standards to stablecoin oversight, India’s VDA review may help shape an investor-focused framework that brings crypto rules closer to global norms.

title: Stablecoin risks seen as minimal in Europe amid low adoption and MiCA: ECB
summary: The European Central Bank said stablecoin risks in the euro area are limited, with crypto trading dominating use and retail adoption under 1%, while monitoring continues.

title: Nasdaq penny stock plans $212M RAIN token play with ex-Italian PM onboard
summary: Former Italian Prime Minister Matteo Renzi will join the Enlivex board to support its policy efforts in establishing the first corporate treasury holding a prediction market token.

title: NPM supply-chain attack compromises major ENS and crypto libraries
summary: A researcher warned that more than 400 NPM libraries, including at least 10 crypto packages mostly tied to ENS, were compromised by Shai Hulud malware.

title: Strategy stock is bleeding, but Saylor ‘won’t back down’ from Bitcoin bet
summary: Despite a steep drop in its share price, Strategy’s Bitcoin stack is in the green and it continues to outperform top tech equities over time.

title: Pump.fun’s massive $436M cash-out turns heads as memecoin mania fades
summary: A decline in speculative crypto investor appetite has seen Pump.fun’s revenue fall by 50% since October, raising concerns about incoming selling pressure.

title: Bitkub exchange eyes Hong Kong IPO as Thai markets slump to 5-year lows: Report
summary: With Thailand’s markets in turmoil, Bitkub is shifting toward Hong Kong’s thriving equity market for a $200 million IPO raise, Bloomberg reported.
